items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: sometimes Eddie Davis was there, Lockjaw Davis

ctx.x: Do you recall who were the, I know in the Basie band they always had great tenor sax players. Do you recall who was in the band at that time?

I recall, if I work really hard I can recall everybody. Well Billy Mitchell was there, sometimes Eddie Davis was there, Lockjaw Davis, Marshall Royal of course was always there, and Poopsie, Charlie Fowlkes was on baritone, and one of our greater friends in the band was Benny Powell, who was a trombone player, and Al Grey and Henry Coker also trombone players, and our absolutely darling friend Freddie Green. Oh, Freddie was just a gem. And Sonny Payne was the drummer and Eddie Jones was the bass player. And we…
